name: Cold-Blooded (S-Class Veritus Champion Sanguine Bond)
body:
The cold-blooded are veritus champions who have seen the worst the world has to offer and decided to fight against it by never giving an inch. They are merciless killers that only give their opponents one chance, if any, to not make the wrong choice. Once that line is crossed, there is no coming back.

Requirements
Alignment: Any lawful.
Blood Doll (Su)

When a cold-blooded veritus champion creates a blood doll, he can convert points from his blood debt into additional hit points for the doll as a free action. Any blood doll with 6 or more total hit points per veritus champion level becomes a Tiny creature whose presence is more threatening. It can flank creatures in adjacent spaces with the veritus champion unless the flanked opponent is immune to fear effects.

Studied Target (Ex)

At 4th level, a cold-blooded veritus champion can study an opponent he can see as a move action. The champion then gains a +1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks attempted against that opponent, and a +1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against it. The DCs of veritus champion class abilities against that opponent increase by 1. A cold-blooded veritus champion can only maintain these bonuses against one opponent at a time; these bonuses remain in effect until either the opponent is dead or the champion studies a new target.

If a cold-blooded veritus champion deals sneak attack damage to a target, he can study that target as an immediate action, allowing him to apply his studied target bonuses against that target (including to the normal weapon damage roll).

This ability replaces blood magic.

Slayer Training

Choose slayer talents or sneak attack +1d6. At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, a cold-blooded veritus champion gains the chosen benefit. At 6th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, he gains the other benefit instead. When he gains a slayer talent at 12th level or higher, the champion can select an advanced slayer talent instead. Sample slayer talents can be found below.

This ability replaces waves of blood and blood possession.

Blood Reader (Ex)

While able to see a studied target, the champion knows exactly how many hit points his opponent has remaining. This only works against living targets.

Deadly Range (Ex)

The champion increases the range at which he can deal sneak attack damage by 10 feet. He can select this talent more than once; its effects stack.

Disrupt Teamwork (Ex)

Prerequisite – Group Study. The champion’s studied targets never count as an ally to their allies for the purpose of flanking the champion or using teamwork feats or the aid another action against him.

Group Study (Ex)

The champion can designate a specific group as his studied target by studying any single member, such as members of the same guild or coven. The group must have specific, similar methods of training or governance; thieves from the same cabal count, but not two disparate rogues, nor two ogres with nothing linking them besides creature type. If unsure, the GM makes the final determination.

The champion applies his studied target bonus against all members of the studied creature’s group, and all members of that group count as one target for the purposes of determining the maximum number of studied targets he can maintain. This bonus remains even if one or more members of the group die after the champion studies them.

Beginning at 7th level, the champion can designate other magically linked creatures, such as those bound by a hivemind or a telepathic bond spell, as a group, but he can target only three members of such a link at a time.

Slowing Strike (Ex)

An opponent damaged by the champion’s sneak attack has its speed halved for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude saving throw against the champion’s blood debt DC negates this effect. Against creatures with multiple types of movement, the champion must choose which movement type to affect. If the champion affects a creature’s flight movement, its maneuverability is reduced by one step; if it’s airborne at the time, it falls unless it succeeds at a DC 10 Fly check. If the champion targets a creature already affected by this ability, its speed and maneuverability are not further reduced; the champion may either extend the duration of that effect by 1d4 rounds or choose another movement type to affect (keeping track of the duration of each affected movement separately).
